ordered_diagnoses: Cancer with variable tumor mutation burden

facts.raw_span: A 71-year-old patient with recurrent stage IIIC papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary
Initial treatment included resection and 6 cycles of adjuvant paclitaxel/carboplatin
One year later, the patient developed liver and cecal metastases
No specific physical examination findings were detailed in the case report
CA125 levels increased from 145.6 to 271.7
CT scans showed: Progressive disease with hepatic and splenic lesions
Metastases to right pleura
Two abdominal masses
Liver and splenic metastases
The patient was negative for germline mutation
The patient was positive for somatic mutation
BRCA-1 mutation (c. 2563C > T p. Q855*) at 33.3% MAF
